eventScripts.script:
logger = system.util.getLogger("hospital.tagscripts")
	logger.info("valueChanged fired. initialChange=%s currentValue=%s" % (initialChange, currentValue.value))

	if initialChange:
		logger.info("Skipping initial change event.")
		return

	parent_path = str(tagPath).rsplit("/", 1)[0]
	results = system.tag.readBlocking([parent_path + "/visitId"])
	visit_id = results[0].value
	logger.info("visit_id read as %s" % visit_id)

	if visit_id and visit_id > 0:
		logger.info("Calling log_vitals for visit_id=%s" % visit_id)
		hospital.patients.log_vitals(visit_id, None, None, currentValue.value)
	else:
		logger.info("No active visit_id, skipping log_vitals call.")
